user.title: Tailscale Helper
user.description: Adds a Connection state sensor to every device from the Tailscale integration. There is nothing to configure — devices are found automatically, and new ones are picked up as they join your tailnet.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. A single Tailscale Helper entry covers every Tailscale device.

data_description.threshold: How long a device may go without checking in to Tailscale before its Connection state turns off. The Tailscale integration refreshes once a minute, so values below about 120 seconds risk false disconnects.
